MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Ethernet switch connects with my recent interest in wired connectivity, although I do not need that many ports.",
    "The USB drive dock has some connection to the adapters I have bought, but that familiarity alone does not give me a reason to choose it now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Most of these items solve storage expansion or replacement needs that I do not currently have.",
    "The RAM and M.2 SSD require a specific upgrade plan and compatible hardware; my past accessory purchases do not mean I am preparing those upgrades.",
    "The streaming stick does not help with the practical computer connections reflected in my recent purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been taken as interest in almost any computer upgrade.",
    "A shared USB connection seems to count too heavily when a storage device serves a different purpose from an Ethernet adapter."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases address specific connection needs, such as adding Ethernet access or connecting a display.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart, and I need a concrete reason to buy another accessory rather than simply finding it potentially useful.",
    "The scale of the need matters: interest in an Ethernet adapter does not imply a need to connect 24 devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in computer equipment but miss the specific connectivity needs that would make me choose something now."
}
